outcomeNote: A mishna stating two parallel rules; no argument is conducted in this unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ טִיפַּת חָלָב שֶׁנָּפְלָה עַל הַחֲתִיכָה, אִם יֵשׁ בָּהּ בְּנוֹתֵן טַעַם בְּאוֹתָהּ חֲתִיכָה – אָסוּר. נִיעֵר אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה, אִם יֵשׁ בָּהּ בְּנוֹתֵן טַעַם בְּאוֹתָהּ קְדֵרָה – אָסוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «a drop of milk that fell on a piece» of meat, «if» the drop «contains» enough milk «to impart flavor to that piece» of meat, i.e., the meat is less than sixty times the size of the drop, the meat is «forbidden.» If «one stirred» the contents of «the pot» and the piece was submerged in the gravy before it absorbed the milk, «if» the drop «contains» enough milk «to impart flavor to» the contents of «that» entire «pot,» the contents of the entire pot are «forbidden.»

moves.summary: a drop of milk absorbed by one piece forbids that piece if it imparts flavor to it
if the pot was stirred, the whole pot is forbidden when the drop imparts flavor to all of it
